risks.title: Uncertainty related to the merger with Boston Scientific
risks.summary: The uncertainty surrounding the proposed merger may harm relationships with employees, customers and partners, and distract management.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the 10-K and describes material impacts on employees, customers, partners and management. The language is strong ("materially and negatively affected"). It is an existential risk as the company will cease to exist. High weighting assigned to M&A risks.

risks.title: Failure of the merger with Boston Scientific
risks.summary: If the merger fails, the company could pay a significant penalty, experience a stock price decline and negative fallout.
risks.score_rationale: The risk of merger failure is explicitly tied to a drop in stock price, a $525M breakup fee, and reputational damage. Repeated mention and alarming language. Category Capital heavily impacted.

risks.title: Operational restrictions prior to the merger
risks.summary: Until the merger closes, the company is limited in its strategic and operational decisions.
risks.score_rationale: The text specifies that the company cannot act freely (contracts, debt, expenditures). This limits its responsiveness to competition. Prominent placement in the 10-K, restrictive language.

risks.title: Product obsolescence due to technological advances
risks.summary: Rapid advances in medical technology could render our existing products obsolete if we fail to adapt.
risks.score_rationale: Recurring risk in product sections, with mention of short product life cycles and technological competition. Concerned language regarding launch delays. Category Technology with high impact in the medical sector.

risks.title: Increased competition in medical devices
risks.summary: We face larger, better-funded competitors, which threatens our market position.
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs detail competition with Medtronic, Stryker, etc. Emphasis on disadvantages in resources and brand recognition. Strong comparative language highlighting risks of market share loss.

risks.title: Margin and pricing pressures
risks.summary: Competitive pressure and rising costs could reduce our margins if we are unable to adjust prices.
risks.score_rationale: Risk is well-developed, with threats to margins, rising material costs, and price competition. Mention of material impacts on results. Category Capital is critical.

risks.title: Litigation related to the merger
risks.summary: Legal proceedings could delay or block the merger, resulting in additional costs and delays.
risks.score_rationale: Risk is noted as common in mergers, with potential impact on timing. Language is cautious but not alarmist. Category Litigation moderately weighted.
